typographie_suggestion.explanation: The typeface features the high contrast between thick and thin strokes, vertical stress, and small, horizontal serifs characteristic of the "Modern" or Didone style (similar to Bodoni or Didot), which was the standard for academic and formal French publishing in the late 19th century.
